B_crypto_press.use: fast catalyst discovery; corroboration required for large score changes

screening_rules: official exchange caution/support-termination/security notice => hard negative for new entry
anonymous screenshot/referral/pump-group claim => zero catalyst weight
community claim needs >=2 independent confirmations OR primary-source confirmation
short-term catalyst should normally be <=24h old; 24-72h only if still market-relevant
news score must be confirmed by Bithumb price/turnover/order-flow structure before affecting entry
external exchange USD prices must never replace or convert into the official Bithumb KRW basis
indicator_stack: true trade-flow imbalance and CVD acceleration
research_policy.note: Community and external derivatives data can improve confirmation but are noisier than primary market data; they are deliberately capped in score impact.
